thread:
Zoe (Product): Quick sync — we need to pick an approach for chat completions shape. Major options: messages[] (role+content) vs single prompt string with role prefixes. Customer asks: preserve system role, support assistant messages in payload, and clean migration. Thoughts?

Ashok (Eng): messages[] is cleaner for tokenization and streaming. role-as-first-class avoids regex parsing of role prefixes. Implementation-wise it's closer to what runtime caches (KV) expect. :+1:

Mia (DevEx): Agree. From SDK ergonomics messages[] maps to chat UI patterns. Also makes function/tool-calling integration easier (we can attach tool metadata to a message). Example: `[{role: "system", content: "..."}, {role: "user", content: "..."}]`

Elena (Customer Success): Customers keep asking for: (1) system role enforced for safety policies, (2) being able to inject assistant messages (for canned replies), and (3) a non-breaking way to opt-in. Many integrate at the prompt layer currently.

Ben (Research): Two risks: (A) backward compatibility for teams sending prompts as strings, (B) how we treat assistant messages — are they considered "history" or "guidance"? That affects token accounting and evals.

Ashok (Eng): For compatibility we could accept both shapes for a transition period. If request has `prompt` string we convert to messages[] by splitting on `

system:` style heuristics — but that's brittle. Prefer encouraging messages[] and providing a small server-side shim that logs warnings and returns a deprecation header.

Mia (DevEx): Migration playbook idea: 1) accept both shapes + deprecation header, 2) SDKs default to messages[] and convert internally, 3) telemetry to find big users, 4) dedicated migration docs + quickstart snippets.

Zoe (Product): Launch criteria draft: - messages[] GA with SDK defaults - system role honored + ACL enforcement - assistant messages supported w/ explicit flag - deprecation path for prompt string + warnings - perf tests show <5% latency regression vs current baseline

Elena (Customer Success): Add acceptance: sample customer (FinReg client) must be able to pin system role and show audit log of injected assistant messages.

Ben (Research): Also add quality guardrails: eval suite that ensures responses don't degrade when migrating from prompt string to messages[]. Tie to Redwood Optimize alerts.

Ashok (Eng): Implementation notes: we need model routing compatibility (some older model backends expect single prompt). Runtime will translate messages[] into model-specific input at the agent layer. Also need to track token attribution per message for cost UI.

specs-bot: New draft spec uploaded: https://redwood.internal/specs/chat-message-shape/v1 — comments open until EOD Friday :rotating_light:

Mia (DevEx): I'll start a migration doc + SDK PR to default to messages[]. Can someone own the compliance/audit piece? @Elena?

Elena (Customer Success): I'll coordinate with the FinReg pilot and collect requirements. Will post a short checklist by tomorrow morning.

Zoe (Product): OK — action items: Ashok: runtime translation plan + perf estimate. Mia: SDK + migration docs. Ben: eval suite. Elena: customer checklist. We'll reconvene Wed 10am to finalize launch criteria. Thanks! :raised_hands:
